research_mode: official GOV.UK primary statistical releases and methodology only; every claim carries a fail-closed limitation; no parcel result, exact incident location, candidate value, local risk score or business result claimed

sources.name: Road Stats19 Scope
verified_claims: STATS19 covers personal-injury road collisions on public roads that become known to the police within 30 days.
limitations: It does not cover every collision or every road-safety event.

sources.name: Road Damage Only Exclusion
verified_claims: Damage-only collisions with no human casualty are outside the reported road casualty statistics.
limitations: Property-damage incidents must not be counted as injury collisions.

sources.name: Road Private Exclusion
verified_claims: Collisions on private roads or in car parks are outside the core STATS19 scope.
limitations: Absence from STATS19 does not imply absence of a private-site collision.

sources.name: Road Detail Items
verified_claims: Around 50 data items are collected for each in-scope collision, including time, location, vehicles, drivers and casualties.
limitations: The existence of detailed fields does not guarantee that each record is complete or correct.

sources.name: Road Processing Chain
verified_claims: Police or their agents process STATS19 records and provide them for Department for Transport checking and analysis.
limitations: Administrative processing introduces possible recording and transfer errors.

sources.name: Road Incomplete Record
verified_claims: STATS19 is not a complete record of all injury collisions and casualties.
limitations: Counts must not be treated as the true total number of road injuries.

sources.name: Road Reporting Obligation
verified_claims: When drivers exchange details, there may be no legal obligation to report an injury collision to police, contributing to under-reporting.
limitations: Unreported collisions cannot be assigned to parcels from STATS19 data.

sources.name: Road Underrecording
verified_claims: Under-reporting includes collisions not reported to police and collisions reported but not recorded.
limitations: Missing records do not support a zero-risk conclusion.

sources.name: Road Cycle Underreporting
verified_claims: Only a small proportion of some single-vehicle pedal-cycle injury collisions are reported to police.
limitations: Police data can disproportionately understate some road-user groups.

sources.name: Road Severity Judgment
verified_claims: It can be difficult for police officers to classify casualties as slight or serious at the roadside.
limitations: Raw severity labels may contain judgment error.

sources.name: Road Injury System Change
verified_claims: Injury-based reporting systems are associated with increased numbers classified as serious injuries.
limitations: Trend breaks can reflect recording-system change rather than real severity change.

sources.name: Road Error Sources
verified_claims: STATS19 errors can arise from uncompleted forms, misreported details and processing failures by police or local authorities.
limitations: Validation reduces but does not eliminate administrative error.

sources.name: Road Validation Layers
verified_claims: Police, local authorities and the Department for Transport use multiple validation layers.
limitations: A validated dataset still retains some missing and incorrect information.

sources.name: Road Location Validation
verified_claims: Validation checks that collision grid references fall within the relevant local-authority boundary.
limitations: Boundary validation does not prove survey-grade positional accuracy or parcel identity.

sources.name: Road Duplicate Check
verified_claims: Department for Transport validation checks for duplicate collision records.
limitations: Duplicate checking does not guarantee every duplicate is detected.

sources.name: Road Orphan Check
verified_claims: Validation checks for orphan casualty or vehicle records without an associated collision.
limitations: Relational consistency does not establish factual accuracy of the underlying event.

sources.name: Road Error Classes
verified_claims: Validation errors are classified as hard, severe or other, and unresolved lower-priority inconsistent values may be set to unknown.
limitations: Unknown values must not be imputed as specific local attributes without a documented method.

sources.name: Road Annual Close
verified_claims: Most validation occurs after a full year of data and the database is closed for annual statistical production after corrections.
limitations: Earlier extracts may differ from final annual data.

sources.name: Road Provisional Estimates
verified_claims: Provisional road casualty figures use less validation and may estimate missing data before final annual figures are available.
limitations: Provisional estimates must not be presented as final exact counts.

sources.name: Road Local Risk Guard
verified_claims: Reported road casualty statistics are useful for broad trend analysis but do not provide a complete parcel-level safety score.
limitations: A local or parcel risk result requires separate spatial, temporal and completeness evidence.
